changes: Radius-based reference paths use a44-unit envelope exceeding the37.556-unit physical navigation radius plus configured clearance.
Straight gap cases use seeds501/5/7 because their generated fields contain88–115-unit circle-compatible crossings; old polygon-recess fixtures are preserved in the full before snapshot.
Near-antiparallel reference curves now use the hairpin branch only for exact180degree turns, preserving continuous endpoint velocity.
Absolute lag/contact/stall budgets were retained; historical tenfold claims were removed because reference routes changed.
The exact same corrected fixtures were run against the saved before production and final production.

initialAccepted.notes: Provisional accepted checkpoint; final comparison uses the later cleanup source and raw samples in cpu/. Quality metrics match exactly.
